# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos turns discovery into ordered action; Awtsmoos.com will deepen search truth without weakening the living application.

## Phase A — archaeology

- Inspect static server response pipeline and MIME/full-document detection.
- Inspect app/game registries and sample entry HTML metadata.
- Inspect imported translation title sources.
- Inspect alias-authored-content indexes/routes.
- Inventory candidate public top-level route families.

## Phase B — implementation

- Add modular app/game SEO metadata resolver and narrow HTML response enricher if the server architecture supports it safely.
- Add translation title resolver using repository-authoritative metadata only.
- Add bounded alias contribution discovery from compact indexes where available.
- Add deliberate public-family discovery additions supported by evidence.
- Add deterministic comment sitemap fixture coverage.

## Phase C — verification

- Run focused unit/regression tests.
- Run existing quality and route suites.
- Start real-data server and inspect representative pages/sitemaps.
- Measure response sizes/latencies and confirm no template errors.

## Phase D — release

- Commit only Generation 2 paths.
- Push with exact remote race checks.
- Guarded production activation.
- Raw public verification and final evidence ledger.
